If this setting is false, client will enable remote support feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

Web also has the same option, which has a higher privilege than this.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enabledarkrightpan.displayName: Set the meeting sidebar to display in dark mode. (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enabledarkrightpan.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, the side panel in meeting will display dark mode.

If this setting is disabled, the side panel appearance will follow setting.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableoriginalsoun.displayName: Client will keep preserve original sound. (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableoriginalsoun.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will keep preserve original sound.

If this setting is disabled, client will not keep preserve original sound and use echo.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablefacebeauty_p.displayName: Enable touch up my appearance (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablefacebeauty_p.description:

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setfacebeautyvalue.description:
Default policy is 25.

This policy depends on EnableFaceBeauty, if EnableFaceBeauty is disabled, SetFaceBeautyValue will not work.

If this policy is a valid integer within 0 to 100, client will use the integer as the the value of "Touch up my appearance".

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:bandwidthlimitup_p.displayName: Set bandwidth limit up value, like "800" unit Kbps; if it's lower than 800Kbps, the value will be 800Kbps (Recommendation Setting)

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableindependentd.displayName: Set to enable independent media data port (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableindependentd.description:
Default policy is no different port.

IIf this setting is true, client will use different ports for media data as below:

AUDIO: 8803
AS: 8802
VIDEO: 8801

If this setting is false, client will use default setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:legacycapturemode_.displayName: Disable Hardware Acceleration for Screen Sharing under Share Screen > Advanced (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:legacycapturemode_.description:

If this setting is false, client will enable the GPU acceleration.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:annotatehardwareac.description:

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablehardwareaccf.description:

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:sharesessiondisabl.displayName: Set to use TCP connection for screen sharing (Recommendation Setting)

If this setting is disabled, client will not remind me before upcoming meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:videorendermethod_.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' as video rendering method.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified rendering method listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Direct3D11 Flip Mode
2 - Direct3D11
3 - Direct3D9
4 - GDI

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:presenttoroomoptim.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will optimize screen sharing for video clip when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this setting is disabled, client will not optimize screen sharing for video clip when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:presenttoroomoptio.displayName: Set specified sharing option when user shares directly to a Zoom Room (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:presenttoroomoptio.description:
Default policy is 1, client will use 'Automatically share desktop' option when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified option listed as below:
0 - Show all sharing options
1 - Automatically share desktop

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:presentinmeetingop.displayName: Set specified sharing option when user shares screen in a meeting (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:presentinmeetingop.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Show all sharing options' option when user shares screen in a meeting.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified option listed as below:
0 - Show all sharing options
1 - Automatically share desktop

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setscreencapturemo.displayName: Set the specified screen capture mode (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setscreencapturemo.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' as screen capture mode.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified mode listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Legacy operating systems
2 - Capture with window filtering
3 - Advanced share with window filtering
4 - Advanced share without window filtering
5 - Secure share with window filtering

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablevideofilter.displayName: Set to disable virtual filters (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablevideofilter.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable virtual filters for meetings.

If this setting is disabled, client will enable virtual filters for meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enabledonotdisturb.displayName: Set to silence system notifications when sharing desktop (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enabledonotdisturb.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will silence system notifications when sharing desktop.

If this setting is disabled, client will not silence system notifications when sharing desktop.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablegpuaccwithsm.displayName: Set to enable hardware acceleration for virtual background (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablegpuaccwithsm.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable hardware acceleration for virtual background.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable hardware acceleration for virtual background.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setsuppressbackgro.displayName: Set a level for suppressing background noise (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setsuppressbackgro.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' by default.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Low
2 - Medium
3 - High

The High option requires the audio enhancement package, and if not present, the client will default to Auto.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setaudiosignalproc.displayName: Set to enable 'signal processing by windows audio device drivers' for windows (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setaudiosignalproc.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Signal processing by windows audio device drivers". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Off(Windows - Raw)
2 - On(Windows - Default)

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:hidephoneincomingc.displayName: Set to hide incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:hidephoneincomingc.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will hide incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting.

If this setting is disabled, client will show incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableshareclipboa.displayName: Set to enable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableshareclipboa.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableclosedcapti.displayName: Set to disable Closed Captioning (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableclosedcapti.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable closed captioning.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable closed captioning.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableqna_policy_.displayName: Set to disable QnA in the webinar (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableqna_policy_.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable QnA in the webinar.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable QnA in the webinar.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableslidecontro.displayName: Set to disable slide control during a presention (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableslidecontro.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable slide control during a presention.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable slide control during a presention.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablemanualclose.displayName: Set to disable manual captions (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablemanualclose.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable manual captions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable manual captions.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablemeetingreac.displayName: Set to disable meeting reactions (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablemeetingreac.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable meeting reactions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable meeting reactions.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewebinarreac.displayName: Set to disable webinar reactions (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewebinarreac.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable webinar reactions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable webinar reactions.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablenonverbalfe.displayName: Set to disable non-verbal feedback (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablenonverbalfe.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable non-verbal feedback.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable non-verbal feedback.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enforceappsigninto.displayName: Set to enforce app local sign in to join Zoom webinar (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enforceappsigninto.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom webinar.

If this policy is enabled, Zoom app cannot join webinar before signing in locally.

If this policy is disabled, Zoom app can join webinar without signing in locally.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.displayName: Set to enforce sign in to join Zoom webinar (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom webinar.

If this setting is true, Zoom app cannot join webinar before signing in.

If this setting is false, Zoom app can join webinar without signing in.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablehardwareopti.displayName: Enable Hardware Acceleration for Video Sharing under Share Screen > Advanced (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablehardwareopti.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will use hardware acceleration to optimize video sharing.

If this setting is disabled, client will not use hardware acceleration to optimize video sharing.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablelightadaptio.displayName: Set to adjust for low light (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablelightadaptio.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will adjust for low light in the user's own video.

If this setting is disabled, client will not adjust for low light in the user's own video.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautolightada.displayName: Set to adjust for low light automatically (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautolightada.description:
Default setting is enabled.

This policy depends on EnableLightAdaption, if EnableLightAdaption is disabled, EnableAutoLightAdaption will not work.

If this setting is enabled, client will adjust for low light in the user's own video automatically.

If this setting is disabled, client will not adjust for low light in the user's own video automatically.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setlightadaptionma.displayName: Set the manual value of "Adjust for low light" (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setlightadaptionma.description:
Default policy is 20.

This policy depends on EnableLightAdaption and EnableAutoLightAdaption, if EnableFaceBeauty is enabled and EnableAutoLightAdaption is disabled, SetLightAdaptionManualValue will take effect.

If this policy is a valid integer within 0 to 100, client will use the integer as the the value of "Adjust for low light".

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautoreversev.displayName: Set to reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautoreversev.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting.

If this setting is disabled, client will not reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablebroadcastbo.displayName: Set to disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablebroadcastbo.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:overrideenforcesig.displayName: Set to allow users to join other cloud's meetings without login if the EnforceSignInToJoin flag is set (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:overrideenforcesig.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will allow users to join other cloud's meetings(e.g. ZFG) without login even if the EnforceSignInToJoin flag is set.

If this setting is disabled, client will respect EnforceSignInToJoin's logic.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable all intercloud features when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable all intercloud features if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable all intercloud features.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting chat when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable meeting chat if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable meeting chat.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable screen share when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable screen share if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable screen share.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting reactions when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable computer file-transfer when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable computer file-transfer.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable annotation when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable annotation if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable annotation.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable whiteboard when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable whiteboard if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable whiteboard.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable local recording when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable local recording if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable local recording.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable closed captioning when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable closed captioning if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable closed captioning.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable remote control when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable remote control if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable remote control.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting polls when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable computer audio when joining other cloud's meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable computer audio.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablelaunchapp4in.displayName: Set to enable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablelaunchapp4in.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingwh.displayName: Set to disable in-meeting whiteboard(New) (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingwh.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will disable in-meeting whiteboard.

If this policy is disabled, client will enable in-meeting whiteboard.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setvideorenderingp.displayName: Set to enable video rendering post processing (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setvideorenderingp.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Video"-"Advanced"-"Video Rendering Post Processing". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Enable
2 - Disable

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:setvideocapturingm.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Video"-"Advanced"-"Video Capturing Method". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Direct Show
2 - Media Foundation

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:notifycmravailable.displayName: Set to show notification when a new recording is available (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:notifycmravailable.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show notification when a new cloud recording is available.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show notification when a new cloud recording is available.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablesidecar_pol.displayName: Set to disable webinar resources (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablesidecar_pol.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable webinar resources.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable webinar resources.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:clicktocalldefault.displayName: Set the default dialer for click-to-dial calls (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:clicktocalldefault.description:
Default setting is 0.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified dialer listed as below:
0 - Zoom Phone
1 - Zoom Contact Center

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablediagnostic_p.displayName: Set to enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablediagnostic_p.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services.

If this setting is disabled, client will not enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablezccnativevid.displayName: Force to enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablezccnativevid.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will force enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center.

If this setting is disabled, client will not force enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:zccmsgaudiosetting.displayName: Setting up message notifications for Zoom Contact Center (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:zccmsgaudiosetting.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Contact Center message notifications". Its default policy is 1, client will default to Always play notifications.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - No effect
1 - Always play notifications
2 - Mute during meetings and calls
3 - Always mute notifications

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:audioenhancementle.displayName: Turns on windows system enhancements for the speaker and microphone in use (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:audioenhancementle.description:
This policy is exactly the same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Advanced"-"Windows system audio enhancements". Its default policy is 0.

0 - Auto: Default value, using default Windows system setting.
1 - On: Turn on the windows system audio enhancements setting.
2 - Off: Turn off the windows system audio enhancements.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:audiocaptureplayba.displayName: Set audio capture and playback API (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:audiocaptureplayba.description:
This policy is exactly the same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Advanced"-"Audio capture and playback API". Its default policy is 0.

0 - Auto: Default value, using synchronous Windows API for audio capture and playback.
1 - Windows Audio Session API: Uses synchronous Windows API for audio capture and playback.
2 - Windows Runtime API: Uses asynchronous Windows Runtime API for audio capture and playback.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshmulticastip_po.displayName: Set IP address for Zoom Mesh local detection (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshmulticastip_po.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid IP address, this policy will allow admins to specify a valid IP address to be a UDP multicast IP for Zoom apps to declare themselves and detect each other in their local sub-network (255.255.255.0). Admins can choose other IP addresses within the range of [224.0.0.1, 239.255.255.255].

If this policy is empty or invalid, this policy will set as 224.0.0.1 by default.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablemeshnetworki.displayName: Set to enable mesh feature (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablemeshnetworki.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will allow the users to use mesh feature.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not allow the users to use mesh feature even if they have a mesh plan.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshmulticastport_.displayName: Set network port for for Zoom Mesh nodes (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshmulticastport_.description:
Default policy is 0.

If this policy is a valid port, client will use this port as the UDP multicast port to communicate with other Zoom Mesh nodes on the network.

If this policy is invalid or 0, this policy will set 36699 as the default port.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshlistenportrang.displayName: Set network port range for Zoom Mesh parent-child node communication (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:meshlistenportrang.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid port range address, the client will use this range to set up listen sockets for connection requests between Mesh parents and children nodes. The nodes will also use this range to send signals and media data.

If this policy is invalid or empty, the client will use "18801-19800" as the default port range.

The format of this string should be "port-port", for example: "18801-19800".

For Zoom Mesh Windows Firewall rules, the configured range must start at port 2000 or higher and span fewer than 5120 ports; otherwise, the firewall rule will not be added.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableguestmesh_po.displayName: Allows users to join an external Webinar as a guest through another account's local Zoom Mesh-enabled network (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableguestmesh_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, this policy will allow users (not on your account) to join an external Webinar through the local Zoom Mesh-enabled network. Other requirements must be met, such as the device having the minimum supported client version for Mesh connections and the associated account setting in the web portal also enabled.

If this setting is disabled, this policy will not allow external users (not on your account) to join an external Webinar through the local Zoom Mesh-enabled network.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:hidecallqueue_poli.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will hide the 'Call Queues' in settings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not hide the 'Call Queues' in settings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:hideblocknumber_po.displayName: Set to hide 'Block Number' feature (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:hideblocknumber_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will hide the 'Block Number' feature.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not hide the 'Block Number' feature.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.displayName: Disable Zoom Notes for Meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable Zoom Notes for Meetings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable Zoom Notes for Meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablesmartmeetin.displayName: Disable Meeting Summary with AI Companion (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablesmartmeetin.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable meeting summary with AI companion.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable meeting summary with AI companion.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableaicqueries_.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable AI Companion questions.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable AI Companion questions.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautocopyconf.displayName: Enable Automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautocopyconf.description:
Default setting is disabled.
If this setting is enabled, client will automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts.
If this setting is disabled, client will not automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableassigntypis.displayName: Disable Allow host to type or assign a participant to type(Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableassigntypis.description:
Default setting is disabled.
If this setting is enabled, client will disable allow host to type or assign a participant to type.
If this setting is disabled,  client will not disable allow host to type or assign a participant to type.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.displayName: Disable Zoom Docs for Meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable Zoom Docs for Meetings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable Zoom Docs for Meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:allowedmeetingsurv.displayName: Allow the client to switch to survivable mode (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:allowedmeetingsurv.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is a valid survivability info string, the client can switch to survivable mode.
If this policy is empty, the client does not support survivable mode.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:keepmeetingontop_p.displayName: Force Zoom Meetings on top of other apps during meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:keepmeetingontop_p.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, Zoom Meetings will be forced to sit on top of other apps during meetings.

If this policy is disabled, Zoom Meetings will not be forced to sit on top of other apps during meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablelocalasr_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will not use local ASR feature.

If this policy is disabled, the client will use local ASR feature.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:optimizeslidecontr.displayName: Enable the use of Office API to control PowerPoint slides (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:optimizeslidecontr.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, clients will be able to use the Office API to control PowerPoint slides.

If this policy is disabled, clients will be unable to use the Office API to control PowerPoint slides.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewindowsmesh.displayName: Prevents the Mesh feature from initiating any User Account Control (UAC) prompts (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewindowsmesh.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will not trigger any User Account Control (UAC) elevation for adding firewall rules required for the mesh feature.

If this policy is disabled, the client may trigger a User Account Control (UAC) prompt.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableautoframing_.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will enable auto-framing.

If this setting is false, client will disable auto-framing.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableforcemaximum.displayName: Prevent camera restart during video sending (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enableforcemaximum.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will keep the maximum camera capture size while sending video to avoid camera restart when higher video resolution is requested during a meeting.
If this policy is disabled, the client may adjust the camera capture size as needed during video sending.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:alwaysusedarktheme.displayName: Always use a dark theme for meetings (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:alwaysusedarktheme.description:
Default policy is enabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will always use a dark theme for in-meeting surfaces.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not force a dark meeting theme and will follow the user appearance preference where supported.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewebinaratte.displayName: Disable computer audio for webinar attendees (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:disablewebinaratte.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will disable computer audio for webinar attendees.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not disable computer audio for webinar attendees.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablesharedcamera.displayName: Enable sharing the camera among Zoom apps (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:enablesharedcamera.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will allow Zoom apps to share the camera through the unified camera setting.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not enable sharing the camera among Zoom apps.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:selfviewmode_polic.displayName: Set the default self-view option (Recommendation Setting)
zoommeetings_hkcu_7_2:selfviewmode_polic.description:
Default setting is 0.
If this policy is set to 0, the client will show self view in the gallery.
If this policy is set to 1, the client will hide self view in the meeting.
If this policy is set to 2, the client will float self view over the gallery.
The value range is 0 to 2.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableclientautoup.description:
This is an old policy for auto update. It is now recommended to use the new AU2 series policies.

Default setting for EXE installation is enabled, default setting for MSI installation is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will auto update itself.

If this setting is disabled, client will not auto update itself.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablecreatingdes.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, no shortcut will be created on desktop.

If this setting is disabled, a shortcut will be created on desktop the first time the user logs in.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartafterrebo.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will automatically start and show itself in task bar after system reboot.

If this policy is set to false, client will not automatically start after system reboot.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartinsystemt.displayName: Auto start client after reboot in system tray
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartinsystemt.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will automatically start and move itself to system tray without showing on task bar after system reboot.

If this policy is set to false, client will not automatically start after system reboot.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:usewininetresolvep.displayName: Always use WinINet to do proxy resolve
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:usewininetresolvep.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is enabled, the client will always use WinINet to do proxy resolve.

If this policy is disabled, the client will use WinHTTP to do proxy resolve first, WinINet will be used as the failover resolver.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablepaccurldown.displayName: Disable wininet proxy resolver use curl to download PAC
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablepaccurldown.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, wininet proxy resolver won't try to download pac by curl.

If this policy is disabled, wininet proxy resolver will try to download pac by curl.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:trypkrequestdirect.displayName: Enabling this option determines whether non-PK proxy requests should go directly based on the result of the PK request
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:trypkrequestdirect.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, and the PK request results in the proxy winning, it will not affect subsequent requests. However, if the PK request results in direct connection winning, all subsequent non-PK requests will use direct connections.

If this policy is disabled, client will have no effect.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxypkrequestdela.displayName: Set the delay time for proxy requests in PK requests
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxypkrequestdela.description:
Default policy is 500.

This policy depends on TryPKRequestDirectFirst. If TryPKRequestDirectFirst is disabled, this policy will have no effect. It sets the delay for proxy requests in PK requests to increase the likelihood of direct connections winning, helps reduce the load on proxy servers.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setssourl_policy.displayName: Set default SSO URL for client login
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setssourl_policy.description:
Default URL is empty, client will manually enter the SSO URL for SSO log in.

Allows you to set the SSO URL.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:forceloginwithsso_.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will be forced to login with SSO only.

If this policy is set to false, client will not be forced to login with SSO.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

If another setting 'Disable login with SSO' is enabled, this policy will be voided and makes no impact no matter this policy is set to true or false.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablegooglelogin.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with Google will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with Google will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablefacebooklog.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with Facebook will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with Facebook will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableloginwithss.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with SSO will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with SSO will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableloginwithma.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with Magic Code will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with Magic Code will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableloginwithmi.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with Microsoft will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with Microsoft will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableloginwithem.displayName: Disable login with email and password
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableloginwithem.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with email and password will be disabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with email will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setaccountidsrestr.displayName: Set account IDs that client is restricted to join meeting hosted by
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setaccountidsrestr.description:
Default setting is empty, client can join meeting hosted by any account IDs.

Allow you to set multiple account IDs that client is restricted to join meeting hosted by. Multiple account IDs can by separated with ,.

For example: 111111,22222

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:closetosystemtray_.displayName: Client will minimize to system tray and not show on task bar when closed
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:closetosystemtray_.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, client will minimize to system tray and not show on task bar when closed.

If this policy is set to false, client will minimize to task bar when closed.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setemaildomainsres.displayName: Set email domains that client is restricted to log in with
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setemaildomainsres.description:
Default setting is empty, client can log in with any email domains.

Allow you to set multiple email domains that client is restricted to log in with. Multiple email accounts can by separated with &.

For example: abc.com&zoom.us

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysusepersonalm.displayName: Client will use personal meeting ID to start meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysusepersonalm.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will use personal meeting ID to start meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will use a random generated meeting ID to start meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:blockuntrustedsslc.displayName: Client will block connection to untrusted SSL certificates
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:blockuntrustedsslc.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is true, client will show a warning dialog when connecting to untrusted SSL certificates, and there is no Trust button to allow user to bypass and continue.

If this setting is false, client will show a warning dialog when connecting to untrusted SSL certificates, but there is a Trust button to allow user to bypass and continue.

If this policy is not set, client use will default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablecloudswitch_.displayName: Enable to switch between Zoom commercial(default) cloud and FedRAMP cloud
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablecloudswitch_.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will be able to switch between Zoom commercial (default) cloud and FedRAMP cloud.

If this policy is set to false, client will work with Zoom commercial (default) cloud only.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableembedbrowser.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will use embedded  browser for SSO.

If this policy is set to false, client will launch system default browser for SSO.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablenewwebview2s.displayName: Enable SSO login using WebView2 browser kernel
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablenewwebview2s.description:
Default policy is false.

This policy depends on EnableEmbedBrowserForSSO, if EnableEmbedBrowserForSSO is false, EnableNewWebView2SSO will not work.

If this policy is set to true, the SSO login page will use Microsoft's latest WebView2 browser kernel.

If this policy is set to false, the SSO login page will use Microsoft's traditional IE browser kernel.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:forcessourl_policy.displayName: Set and lock the default SSO URL for client login
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:forcessourl_policy.description:
Default URL is empty, client will manually enter the SSO URL for SSO log in.

If your organization is using FedRAMP cloud, you can input URL like: your-org-name.zoomgov.com; if your organization is using CN cluster, you can input URL like: your-org-name.zoom.com.

Allows you to set and lock the SSO URL.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keepsignedin_polic.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will always enable 'remember me' feature.

If this setting is false, user needs to input credential for every time of Zoom application launch.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setwebdomain_polic.displayName: Set default web domain for client login and join meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setwebdomain_polic.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid string, client will always use this domain to login and join meeting.

If this setting is empty, client will use the default cloud "https://zoom.us" and/or "https://zoom.com" to login and join meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.displayName: Set to enforce sign in to join Zoom meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom meeting.

If this setting is true, Zoom app cannot join meeting before signing in.

If this setting is false, Zoom app can join meeting without signing in.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablephonelogin_p.displayName: Set to enable login with phone
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablephonelogin_p.description:
Default setting is false.

If this setting is false, login with Phone will be disabled.

If this setting is true, login with Phone will be enabled.

If this setting is not set, it will be disable if IT installed the client, otherwise use app-default (enable)

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableapplelogin_p.displayName: Set to enable login via Apple OAuth
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableapplelogin_p.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, login with Apple will be enabled.

If this setting is disabled, login with Apple will be disabled.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:defaultuseportrait.description:
Default policy is not to use portrait view.

If this setting is true, client will use portrait view.

If this setting is false, client will not use portrait view.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:embeduseragentstri.displayName: Set to embed one specified user agent string for all HTTP requests from Zoom client application; this piece of string will be appended to the end of regular user agent string.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:embeduseragentstri.description:
Default policy is to use regular user agent string only.

If this setting is not empty, client will append the value to the regular user agent string.

If this setting is empty, client will use regular user agent string.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:embeddevicetag_pol.displayName: Set to embed one specified device tag string for all HTTP requests from Zoom client application; this piece of string will be appended to the head of the regular HTTP requests.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:embeddevicetag_pol.description:
Default policy is to ignore this tag.

If this setting is not empty, client will append the value to the HTTP request head.

If this setting is empty, client will ignore the specified head.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautouploaddu.displayName: Enable to send dumps to Zoom backend to improve the service
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautouploaddu.description:
Default policy is no automatically uploading dumps.

If this setting is true, client will automatically upload dumps.

If this setting is false, client will not automatically upload dumps.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautouploadme.displayName: Enable to send critical-failure-logs to Zoom backend to improve the service
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautouploadme.description:
Default policy is no automatically uploading critical-failure-logs.

If this setting is true, client will automatically upload critical-failure-logs.

If this setting is false, client will not automatically upload critical-failure-logs.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disable3rdmoduleve.displayName: Disable to check the signature of the third-party library.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disable3rdmoduleve.description:
Default policy is false.

If this setting is true, client will turn off the signature check of the third-party library.

If this setting is false, client will turn on the signature check of the third-party library.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setacceventsoption.description:
If this policy is a valid string, client will parse the string and set the selected options on.

If this policy is empty, client will set all options on.

String represents a numeric value. The values and options enabled are as follows:
IM CHAT RECEIVED = 1
PARTICIPANT JOINED LEFTED MEETING = 2
PARTICIPANT JOINED LEFED WAITING ROOM = 4
AUDIO MUTED UNMUTED BY HOST = 8
VIDEO STOPED BY HOST = 16
SCREEN SHARING STARTED STOPED BY PARTICIPANT = 32
RECORDING PERMISSION GRANTED REVOKED = 64
PUB MEETING CHAT RECEIVED = 128
PRI MEETING CHAT RECEIVED = 256
MEETING FILE UPLOADED = 512
CC AVAILABLE = 1024
CC TYPING PRIVILEGE GRANTED REVOKED = 2048
HOST PRIVILEGE GRANTED REVOKED = 4096
COHOST PRIVILEGE GRANTED REVOKED = 8192
REMOTE CONTROL PERMISSION GRANTED REVOKED = 16384
LIVESTREAM STARTED STOPPED = 32768
PARTICIPANT RAISED LOWERED HAND = 65536
QA QUESTION RECEIVED = 131072
QA ANSWER RECEVIEVED = 262144
ROLE CHANGED TO PANELIST = 524288
ROLE CHANGED TO ATTENDEE = 1048576

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:integratezoomwitho.displayName: Set to integrate Zoom with Outlook
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:integratezoomwitho.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will integrate Zoom with Outlook.

If this policy is set to false, client will not integrate Zoom with Outlook.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectconne.displayName: Disable to create a specified PK request with direct connection.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectconne.description:
In common case, there always be a direct connection request for login/join meeting requests; if this option is ON, the client application will try with system proxy (if have) at first

Default policy is false.

If this setting is true, client will disable the direct connection PK request.

If this setting is false, client will always try direct connection even there is proxy server configuration.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectconne.displayName: Disable all direct connections to Zoom web service
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectconne.description:
Default policy is false.

If this setting is true, client will disable the direct connection to Zoom web service.

If this setting is false, client will always try direct connection even there is proxy server configuration.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxypac_policy.displayName: Set proxy server to client with PAC URL
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxypac_policy.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid string, client will adopt the proxy setting as the PAC URL pointed.

If this setting is empty, client will use other proxy settings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxyserver_policy.displayName: Set proxy server to client as named proxy like server:port
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxyserver_policy.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid string, client will parse the string and use it as the proxy server.

If this setting is empty, client will use other proxy settings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxybypass_policy.displayName: Set proxy by-pass rule to client
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxybypass_policy.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid string, client will parse the string and use it as the proxy by-pass rule.

If this setting is empty, client will use other proxy settings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setdevicepolicytok.displayName: Set device policy's token from web settings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setdevicepolicytok.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this setting is a valid string, client will append the value to the web request and get policies from web settings.

If this setting is empty, client will not append the value.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.displayName: Disable keep signed in if signing in via SSO
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, user needs to input SSO credential for every time of Zoom application launch.

If this policy is false, client will keep signed in if signing in via SSO.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.displayName: Disable keep signed in if signing in via Google
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, user needs to input Google credential for every time of Zoom application launch.

If this policy is false, client will keep signed in if signing in via Google.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.displayName: Disable keep signed in if signing in via Facebook
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablekeepsignedi.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, user needs to input Facebook credential for every time of Zoom application launch.

If this policy is false, client will keep signed in if signing in via Facebook.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomapps_po.displayName: Set to disable Zoom Apps feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomapps_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will disable Zoom Apps feature.

If this policy is disabled, client will enable Zoom Apps feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablesilentautoup.displayName: Enable client to auto update silently
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablesilentautoup.description:
This is an old policy for auto update. It is now recommended to use the new AU2 series policies.

Default policy is enabled.

This policy depends on EnableClientAutoUpdate, if EnableClientAutoUpdate is disabled, EnableSilentAutoUpdate will not work, even if it is enabled. (For msi package, EnableClientAutoUpdate is disabled by default. For exe, it is enabled)

If this policy is enabled, client will auto update itself silently.

If this policy is disabled, client will auto update itself and prompt users the update dialog.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setnorevocationche.displayName: Set a whitelist to ignore the revocation check error
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setnorevocationche.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is empty, client will ignore this policy.

If this policy is a valid string, which means the whitelist domain has no protocol, path, params and is divided by ";", client will ignore the revocation error for the whitelist domain.

Example settings "foo.com;bar.com"

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxydetectinterva.displayName: Set the proxy detect interval in seconds
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:proxydetectinterva.description:
Default setting value is 0.

If this policy is set, client will use to set the proxy detect interval and will enable PAC cache.

If this policy is 0, client will use the hardcode detect interval 30 min.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforceappsigninto.displayName: Set to enforce app local sign in to join Zoom meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforceappsigninto.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom meeting.

If this policy is enabled, Zoom app cannot join meeting before signing in locally.

If this policy is disabled, Zoom app can join meeting without signing in locally.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwayschecklatestv.displayName: Enable client to check the latest version instead of the stable version
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwayschecklatestv.description:
This is an old policy for auto update. It is now recommended to use the new AU2 series policies.

Default policy is disabled.

This policy depends on EnableClientAutoUpdate, if EnableClientAutoUpdate is disabled, AlwaysCheckLatestVersion will not work, even if it is enabled. (For msi package, EnableClientAutoUpdate is disabled by default. For exe, it is enabled)

If EnableSilentAutoUpdate is enabled(default is enabled), it's better to use SetUpdatingChannel instead of this policy.

If this policy is enabled, client will check the latest version in the background.

If this policy is disabled, client will check the stable version in the background.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setenrolltoken4clo.displayName: Set enrollment token for cloud-based device management
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setenrolltoken4clo.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is empty, client will ignore this policy.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use this string to enroll to cloud-based device management.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableautolaunchs.displayName: Disable client to launch SSO login web page automatically
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableautolaunchs.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will not launch SSO login web page automatically.

If this policy is disabled, client will launch SSO login web page automatically.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setupdatingchannel.displayName: Set the specified update channel when silent auto update is enabled
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setupdatingchannel.description:
This is an old policy for auto update. It is now recommended to use the new AU2 series policies.

Default policy is 0, client will use 'Slow' as updating channel when the client auto updates silently.

This policy depends on EnableSilentAutoUpdate, if EnableSilentAutoUpdate is disabled, SetUpdatingChannel will not work.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified channel listed as below:
0 - Slow
1 - Fast

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableupdateto64b.displayName: Disable client update from 32 bit to 64 bit
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableupdateto64b.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will not update from 32 bit to 64 bit.

If this policy is disabled, client will update from 32 bit to 64 bit.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomappsgue.displayName: Set to disable Zoom Apps for users who are not authenticated
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomappsgue.description:
Default policy is disabled.

This policy works independently of old flag 'DisableZoomApps'.

If this policy is enabled, client will disable Zoom Apps for users who are not authenticated.

If this policy is disabled, client will enable Zoom Apps for users who are not authenticated.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:preproxydetectpoli.displayName: Set up to use the different policy to do proxy pre-detection
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:preproxydetectpoli.description:
Default policy is 0.

If this policy is 0, use the default policy to do pre-detection.

If this policy is 1, use wininet to do pre-detection(In some PAC cases, it will be faster).

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledoublecheck.displayName: Disable double-checking winhttp proxy resolver query results
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledoublecheck.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, winhttp proxy resolver query will skip the step for double check result via wininet.

If this policy is disabled, it will have no effect.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewinextendpro.displayName: Set to support Windows extend protection for NTLM authentication
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewinextendpro.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will support Windows extend protection for NTLM authentication.

If this policy is disabled, client will not support Windows extend protection for NTLM authentication.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemultipleacc.displayName: Set to disable the ability to sign into multiple Zoom accounts and switch accounts
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemultipleacc.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will disable the ability to sign into multiple Zoom accounts and switch accounts.

If this policy is disabled, client will not disable the ability to sign into multiple Zoom accounts and switch accounts.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableusersignup_.displayName: Set to hide the sign up button
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableusersignup_.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will hide the sign up button on the login dialog.

If this policy is disabled, the client will not hide the sign up button on the login dialog.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomonboard.displayName: Set to hide the onboarding process for new users
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomonboard.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will hide the onboarding process for new users.

If this policy is disabled, the client will not hide the onboarding process for new users.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:hidelogoutbtn_poli.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will hide the 'Sign out' button.

If this policy is disabled, the client will not hide the 'Sign Out' button.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablediscoverwha.displayName: Set to hide the 'Discover What's New' menu
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablediscoverwha.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will hide the 'Discover What's New' menu.

If this policy is disabled, the client will not hide the 'Discover What's New' menu.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablep2pstuntraf.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will disable p2p stun traffic.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not disable p2p stun traffic.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomifnotzd.displayName: Disable app if ZDM enrollment fails
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablezoomifnotzd.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will disable the Zoom app if enrollment of this device into Zoom Device Management fails.
If this policy is disabled, client will not disable the Zoom app if enrollment of this device into Zoom Device Management fails.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledumptpstatin.displayName: Enable saving meeting statistics data to local log file
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledumptpstatin.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is true, client will save meeting statistics data to local log file.

If this setting is false, client will not save meeting statistics data to local log file.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablereportprobl.displayName: Disable reporting of problems on the client
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablereportprobl.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will not be able to report problems.
If this policy is disabled, the client can report problems.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewindowsgenf.displayName: Disable full dump generation on windows platform client
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewindowsgenf.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will not be able to generate full dump.
If this policy is disabled, the client can generate full dump.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewindowsdown.displayName: Disable download webview on windows platform client
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewindowsdown.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will not be able to download webview.
If this policy is disabled, the client can download webview.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableprompt32bit.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the 32-bit client will prompt a warning.
If this policy is disabled, the 32-bit client do not prompt a warning.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableproxydetectf.displayName: Enable ProxyDetect logic for 30 mins refresh and networkchange
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableproxydetectf.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the Windows client will trigger proxy detect logic for 30 mins and network change situation.
If this policy is disabled, the Windows client will not trigger proxy detect logic for 30 mins and network change situation.
If this policy is not set, the Windows client will not trigger proxy detect logic for 30 mins and network change situation.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablenewsetting_.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will not use the new setting UI.
If this policy is disabled, the client will use the new setting UI.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemynotes_pol.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will disable the My Notes feature.
If this policy is disabled, the client will enable the My Notes feature.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablenewsigninui_.description:
Default policy is enabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will use the new login UI.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not use the new login UI.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:webviewproxy_polic.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is empty or invalid, client will ignore this policy.
If this policy is a valid string, client will use this string as the webview proxy server.
If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:exitpreference_pol.description:
This policy has a higher priority than CloseToSystemTray.

Default policy is 0.

If this policy is set to 0, the client will minimize to the system tray when the main window is closed.

If this policy is set to 1, the client will fully exit when the main window is closed.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledesktopscre.displayName: Disable the screenshot feature in the desktop client
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledesktopscre.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, all screenshot functions on the client will be disabled.
If this policy is disabled, all screenshot functions on the client are working properly.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:databasejournaldel.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will enable the 'journal_mode=DELETE' option in SQLite to enhance compatibility and performance in inefficient storage environments such as NFS or NAS.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not enable this option in SQLite.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautodetected.displayName: Automatically detect voice activity to create my notes
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautodetected.description:
Default policy is enabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will notify user when voice activity is detected on specified apps.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not notify user when voice activity is detected on specified apps.
If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:generatedidusingma.displayName: Generate device ID based on MAC addresses to distinguish devices
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:generatedidusingma.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will generate device ID based on MAC addresses to distinguish devices.
If this policy is disabled, the client will continue to use the default device ID generation method.
If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:memorysaverenabled.displayName: Enable Memory Saver for WebView recycle behavior.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:memorysaverenabled.description:
Default policy is enabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will apply Memory Saver behavior, and recycle level can be controlled by zPolicy_MemorySaverOptimization.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not apply Memory Saver optimization behavior.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:memorysaveroptimiz.displayName: Set Memory Saver optimization level for WebView recycle behavior
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:memorysaveroptimiz.description:
Default policy is 3 (Default).
If this policy is set to 1, the client will use Light optimization level.
If this policy is set to 2, the client will use Default optimization level.
If this policy is set to 3, the client will use Aggressive optimization level.
If this policy is not set, is invalid, or is out of scope, the client will use the default setting.
If zPolicy_MemorySaverEnabled is disabled, this policy will not take effect.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableinstallstan.displayName: Prevent installation of standard clients in VDI environments.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableinstallstan.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, the installation of the standard client in a VDI environment will be blocked.

If this setting is disabled, the standard client can be installed normally in a VDI environment.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablecrasheventlo.displayName: Control whether the Zoom client generates an event in Windows Event Log ("Event Viewer"-"Windows Logs"-"Application") when it crashes.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablecrasheventlo.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, it generates an event in Windows Event Log ("Event Viewer"-"Windows Logs"-"Application") when the Zoom client crashes.

If this setting is disabled, it will have no effect.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:v4retryforv6tlserr.displayName: Enable IPv4 retry for IPv6 TLS errors
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:v4retryforv6tlserr.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, when the client resolves both IPv4 and IPv6 addresses and the IPv6 TLS connection fails, the client will retry the connection using IPv4.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not perform this IPv4 retry for IPv6 TLS errors.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:forceenablewebview.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will force WebView recycle behavior to reclaim memory from supported WebView-based tabs according to the configured recycle rules.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not force WebView recycle behavior and will use the normal Memory Saver and WebView recycle settings.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewebrequestra.displayName: Enable server-driven passive rate limiting for web requests
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewebrequestra.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will enable server-driven passive rate limiting for web requests and report related rate limit telemetry.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not enable server-driven passive rate limiting for web requests.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:webrequestratelimi.displayName: Set the client mode for web request rate limiting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:webrequestratelimi.description:
Default setting is 1.
If this policy is set, the client will use the specified mode for web request rate limiting.
The value range is 0 to 3: 0 disables client-side web request rate limiting, 1 enables telemetry only, 2 enables rate limiting without telemetry, and 3 enables both telemetry and rate limiting.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.
