zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartphonemyno.displayName: Enable auto-start for Zoom Phone My Notes
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartphonemyno.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will automatically start Zoom Phone My Notes.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not automatically start Zoom Phone My Notes.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableasyncproxyre.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will resolve proxy settings asynchronously.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not use asynchronous proxy resolution.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablebatchproxyre.displayName: Enable batch proxy resolution through the async path
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablebatchproxyre.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will resolve multiple proxy requests in a batch through the asynchronous proxy path.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not use batch proxy resolution through the asynchronous path.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehandleredire.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will handle redirect proxy during proxy resolution.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not handle redirect proxy during proxy resolution.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablenewhomepage_.description:
Default policy is enabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will use the new home page.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not use the new home page.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewinzsafechec.displayName: Set whether zSafeChecker is allowed to run
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablewinzsafechec.description:
Default setting is 0.
If this policy is set to 0, the client will allow zSafeChecker.exe to run.
If this policy is set to 1, the client will skip the Program Files folder when running zSafeChecker.exe.
If this policy is set to 2, the client will disallow zSafeChecker.exe from running.
The value range is 0 to 2.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setmultiplessovani.description:
Default setting is empty.
If this policy is set, the client will use the specified SSO vanity URLs and users can select from them.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableautoupda.displayName: Set to enable the auto-update feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableautoupda.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will auto update itself.

If this policy is disabled, client will not auto update itself.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_setupdatechann.displayName: Set the specified update channel when auto-update feature is enabled
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_setupdatechann.description:
Default policy is empty, client will subscribe 'Slow' as update channel when the auto-update feature is enabled.

This policy depends on AU2_EnableAutoUpdate, if AU2_EnableAutoUpdate is disabled, AU2_SetUpdateChannel will not work.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified channel listed as below:
'0' - Slow
'1' - Fast

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableshowzoom.displayName: Set to show 'Zoom Updates' in the general settings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableshowzoom.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will show 'Zoom Updates' in the general settings.

If this policy is disabled, client will hide 'Zoom Updates' in the general settings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableupdateav.displayName: Set to show a banner on the homepage when updates are available
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableupdateav.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will show a banner on the homepage when updates are available.

If this policy is disabled, client will not show a banner on the homepage when updates are available.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enablepromptup.displayName: Set to prompt the user to update when exiting a meeting or webinar if an update is available
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enablepromptup.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will prompt the user to update when exiting a meeting or webinar if an update is available.

If this policy is disabled, client will not prompt the user to update when exiting a meeting or webinar if an update is available.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableupdatesu.displayName: Set to show a toast indicating that an update has been successfully applied
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enableupdatesu.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will show a toast indicating that an update has been successfully applied on the next launch after an update has been applied.

If this policy is disabled, client will not show a toast indicating that an update has been successfully applied on the next launch after an update has been applied.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enablemanualup.displayName: Set to enable the manual 'Check for Updates' option
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_enablemanualup.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will enable the 'Check for Updates' option.

If this policy is disabled, client will disable the 'Check for Updates' option.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_deployspecific.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is empty or invalid, client will ignore this policy.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use this string as the update target version.

If the Zoom's version is lower than the specific version, the client will auto update to the specific version. If the Zoom's version is higher than the specific version, the client will not do anything.

The format of this string should be major.minor.patch.build, for example: "5.10.4.5035"

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_update3rdstora.displayName: Set a local storage url for update
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_update3rdstora.description:
Default policy is empty.

This policy depends on AU2_DeploySpecificVersion, if AU2_DeploySpecificVersion is empty, AU2_Update3rdStorageUrl will not work.

Stored installation package needs to be named according to the following rules: ZoomInstallerFull.msi, x64_ZoomInstallerFull.msi, winarm64_ZoomInstallerFull.msi.

If the user's installation package can be downloaded through such a link: "http://127.0.0.1/x64_ZoomInstallerFull.msi", this string should be "http://127.0.0.1".

If this policy is a valid string, client will use this string as the update download url when the target version of the update is specified.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_setupdatesched.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is empty or invalid, client will download the update package at anytime.

If this policy is a valid string, client will download the update package within the specified time period.

The format of this string should be HHMM-HHMM, for example: "0900-1800" means 09:00 to 18:00, "1800-0400" means 18:00 to the next day 04:00.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_installatidlet.displayName: Set to enable auto update installation when idle
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_installatidlet.description:
Default policy is disabled.

This policy depends on AU2_EnableAutoUpdate, if AU2_EnableAutoUpdate is disabled, AU2_InstallAtIdleTime will not work.

If this policy is enabled, client will enable auto update installation when idle.

If this policy is disabled, client will disable auto update installation when idle.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_safeupgradeper.displayName: Set to install auto updates within a specified time period
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_safeupgradeper.description:
Default policy is "0000-0400".

This policy depends on AU2_InstallAtIdleTime, if AU2_InstallAtIdleTime is disabled, AU2_SafeUpgradePeriod will not work.

If this policy is empty or invalid, client will install auto updates within the default time period when idle.

If this policy is a valid string, client will install auto updates within the specified time period when idle.

The format of this string should be HHMM-HHMM, for example: "0900-1800" means 09:00 to 18:00, "1800-0400" means 18:00 to the next day 04:00.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_updatechannelc.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is empty or invalid, client will set Slow and Fast as the default update channel list.

If this policy is a valid string, client will set the update channel list according to the string.

The format of this string should be {channel id}:{channel name} and use semicolon to separate different channels, for example: "0:Slow" will add Slow to the update channel list, "0:Slow;1:Fast" will add Slow and Fast to the update channel list.

The following are the two public update channels:
"0" - Slow
"1" - Fast

Note:
1.Slow will be added to the list even if it is not written to string.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_limitmanualupd.displayName: Set manual check for updates to the version defined by Auto Update
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_limitmanualupd.description:
Default policy is disabled.

This policy depends on AU2_EnableAutoUpdate and AU2_EnableManualUpdate, if AU2_EnableAutoUpdate or AU2_EnableManualUpdate is disabled, AU2_LimitManualUpdateVersion will not work.

If this policy is enabled, client will set manual check for updates to the version defined by Auto Update.

If this policy is disabled, client will set manual check for updates to the latest version.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:au2_allowdowngrade.description:
This policy is used for 'Downgrade a specific version of the Zoom client' in the Zoom Device Management. Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will be allowed to downgrade.

If this policy is disabled, client will not be allowed to downgrade.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablelinkpreview.displayName: Client will disable and hide link preview feature in chat
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablelinkpreview.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide link preview feature in chat.

If this setting is disabled, link preview feature will be enabled in chat.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setmessengerdonotd.displayName: Set to move messages with new replies to the bottom of the chat
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setmessengerdonotd.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will move messages with new replies to the bottom of the chat.

If this setting is disabled, client will not move messages with new replies to the bottom of the chat.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showvoicemessagebu.displayName: Set to show audio message button
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showvoicemessagebu.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show audio message button.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show audio message button.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowimnotifi.displayName: Set to show notification banner on screen util dismissed
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowimnotifi.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show notification banner on screen util dismissed.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show notification banner on screen util dismissed.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:playsoundforimmess.displayName: Set to play sound when receive a new message
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:playsoundforimmess.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will play sound when receive a new message.

If this setting is disabled, client will not play sound when receive a new message.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showimmessageprevi.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show message preview.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show message preview.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:muteimnotification.displayName: Set to mute chat notifications while in a meeting or internal call
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:muteimnotification.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will mute chat notifications while in a meeting or internal call.

If this setting is disabled, client will not mute chat notifications while in a meeting or internal call.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showvideomessagebu.displayName: Set to show video message button
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showvideomessagebu.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show video message button.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show video message button.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showprofilephotosi.displayName: Set to show profile photos next to direct messages
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showprofilephotosi.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show profile photos next to direct messages.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show profile photos next to direct messages.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keeponlyonesection.displayName: Keep only one section open in Team Chat
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keeponlyonesection.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client only allow one section opened at a time.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not limit sections
If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:separateimchatandc.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client organize chats by section.
If this policy is disabled, the client will not Organize chats by section
If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableimfiletrans.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this policy is enabled, the client will disable IM file transfer feature when current domain is not exist in the list of AllowedIMFileTransferDomain.
If this policy is disabled, the client will use the default setting.
If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:allowedimfiletrans.displayName: Allowed IM file transfer domain list
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:allowedimfiletrans.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is a valid string(for example:zoom1.us),and DisableIMFileTransfer is enabled, the client will only allow the domain zoom1.us to IM transfer feature. Multiple domains can be separated with & (for example: zoom1.us&zoom2.us)
If this setting is empty, and DisableIMFileTransfer is enabled, client will disable IM transfer feature for all domains.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:messagenotificatio.displayName: Setting up message notifications preferences for Team Chat
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:messagenotificatio.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Team Chat"-"Message Preferences". Its default policy is 1, client will default to notify direct messages, mentions, and replies.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - All messages
1 - Direct messages, mentions, and replies
2 - Off

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keepunreadmessages.displayName: Keep all unread messages at the top of recent chats
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keepunreadmessages.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this setting is true, client will keep all unread messages at the top of recent chats.

If this setting is false, client will not keep all unread messages at the top of recent chats.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showunreadcountfor.displayName: Show unread message count for channels
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showunreadcountfor.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this setting is true, client will show unread message count for channels.

If this setting is false, client will not show unread message count for channels.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showunreadcountfor.displayName: Show unread message count for meeting chats
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showunreadcountfor.description:
Default policy is disabled.
If this setting is true, client will show unread message count for meeting chats.

If this setting is false, client will not show unread message count for meeting chats.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:unreadvieworder_po.displayName: Where to start when viewing unread messages in a channel
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:unreadvieworder_po.description:
Its default policy is 0, client will default to start viewing unread messages at the first unread message.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Start at the first unread message
1 - Start at the latest unread message

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:receivenotificatio.displayName: Setting keywords as the basis for triggering message notifications
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:receivenotificatio.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is a valid string, the client will trigger message notifications based on these keywords.
If this setting is empty, client will trigger message notifications normally.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:preferredlanguage_.displayName: Use this language when translating messages
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:preferredlanguage_.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is a valid string(for example:en), the client will use this language when translating messages
If this setting is empty, the client will use the default language when translating messages.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:turnoffvideocamera.displayName: Turn off video camera when joining meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:turnoffvideocamera.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will turn off video camera when joining meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will turn on video camera when joining meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autojoinvoip_polic.displayName: Auto connect audio with VoIP when joining meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autojoinvoip_polic.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will automatically connect audio with VoIP when joining meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will not automatically connect audio with VoIP when joining meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autoenabledualmoni.displayName: Enable dual monitor if system supports
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autoenabledualmoni.description:
Default setting is disbled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enabled dual monitor mode for meeting.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable dual monitor mode for meeting.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enterfullscreenwhe.displayName: Client will enter full screen mode when viewing shared screen
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enterfullscreenwhe.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, client will enter full screen mode when viewing shared screen.

If this policy is set to false, client will stay in windowed mode when viewing shared screen.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:fitcontentwhenview.displayName: Client will resize content to fit the window when viewing shared screen
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:fitcontentwhenview.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, client will resize content to fit the window when viewing shared screen.

If this policy is set to false, client will not resize content to fit the window when viewing shared screen.

If this policy is not set, client will default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehdvideo_poli.displayName: Client will capture and send camera video in HD 720p format
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehdvideo_poli.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will capture and send camera video in HD 720p format.

If this setting is disabled, client will capture and send camera video in 360p format.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:controlallappswhen.displayName: All applications can be controlled during remote control session
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:controlallappswhen.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, all applications can be controlled during remote control session.

If this policy is set to false, system applications cannot be controlled during remote control session.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:recordingfilepath_.displayName: Set path for local meeting recording files
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:recordingfilepath_.description:
Default path is User/Document folder.

Allows you to set path for local meeting recording files.

For example: C:\MyZoomRecordings

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableaeromodedur.displayName: Disable Aero mode when screen sharing on Windows 7 system
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableaeromodedur.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, Aero mode will be disabled when screen sharing on Windows 7 system.

If this setting is disabled, Aero mode will not be disabled when screen sharing on Windows 7 system.

If this setting is not set, client will default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowmeetingc.displayName: Client will always show meeting controls
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowmeetingc.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will always show meeting controls.

If this policy is set to false, some meeting controls like the meeting toolbar will automatically hide after idle for a few seconds and show on mouse movement or keyboard stroke event.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enterfullscreenwhe.displayName: Client will automatically enter full screen mode when joining a meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enterfullscreenwhe.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will automatically enter full screen mode when joining a meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will stay in windowed mode when joining a meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartmynotes_p.displayName: Client will automatically start My notes when joining a meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autostartmynotes_p.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will automatically start My notes when joining a meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will not automatically start My notes when joining a meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:promptconfirmwhenl.displayName: Client will prompt confirmation when leaving a meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:promptconfirmwhenl.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, client will will prompt confirmation when leaving a meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will leave a meting without prompt confirmation.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowconnecte.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will show meeting timers.

If this policy is set to false, client will not show meeting timers.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:mutevoipwhenjoinme.displayName: Client will mute VoIP when joining a meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:mutevoipwhenjoinme.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will mute VoIP when joining a meeting.

If this policy is set to false, client will unmute VoIP when joining a meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autohidenovideouse.displayName: Client will hide users with video turned off in gallery View
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autohidenovideouse.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is set to true, client will hide users with video turned off in gallery View.

If this policy is set to false, client will show users with video turned off in gallery View.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autoadjustaudioset.displayName: Client will adjust audio settings automatically
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:autoadjustaudioset.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is set to true, client will adjust audio settings automatically.

If this policy is set to false, client will not adjust audio settings automatically, user has to manually adjust audio settings in Settings/Audio window.

If this policy is not set, client will use default policy.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesharescreen.displayName: Client will disable and hide Share Screen feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesharescreen.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide Share Screen feature.

If this setting is disabled, Share Screen feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeetingchat.displayName: Client will disable and hide in meeting chat feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeetingchat.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide in meeting chat feature.

If this setting is disabled, in meeting chat feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use local configured setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeetingfile.displayName: Client will disable and hide the in meeting computer file-transfer feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeetingfile.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide the in meeting computer file-transfer feature.

If this setting is disabled, the in meeting computer file-transfer feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeeting3rdp.displayName: Client will hide and disable the in meeting file-transfer from third-party, like Box, Dropbox.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeeting3rdp.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will hide and disable the in meeting third-party file-transfer feature.

If this setting is disabled, the in meeting third-party file-transfer feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablelocalrecord.displayName: Client will disable and hide local recording feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablelocalrecord.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide local recording feature.

If this setting is disabled, local recording feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablecloudrecord.displayName: Client will disable and hide cloud recording feature
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablecloudrecord.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide cloud recording feature.

If this setting is disabled, cloud recording feature will be enabled.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevideocamera.displayName: Client will disable and hide ability to send video
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevideocamera.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide ability to send video.

If this setting is disabled, client will be able to send video.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablereceivevide.displayName: Client will disable and hide ability to receive video
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablereceivevide.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide ability to receive video.

If this setting is disabled, client will be able to receive video.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableannotation_.displayName: Client will disable and hide ability to annotate over shared screen
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableannotation_.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable and hide ability to annotate over shared screen.

If this setting is disabled, client will enable ability to annotate over shared screen.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablemirroreffect.displayName: Client will enable mirror effect of your video camera
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablemirroreffect.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable mirror effect over your video camera.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable mirror effect of your video camera.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehidcontrol_p.displayName: Client will enable HID audio device control
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehidcontrol_p.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable HID audio device control.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable HID audio device control.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowvideopre.displayName: Always show video preview dialog when joining a video meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:alwaysshowvideopre.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will always show video preview dialog when joining a video meeting.

If this setting is false, client will never show video preview dialog before joining any meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablecomputeraud.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable computer audio.

If this setting is disabled, client will use computer audio.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablesplitscreen_.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable side-by-side mode.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable side-by-side mode.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableremotecontr.displayName: During screen sharing, the person who is sharing won't allow others to control the shared content.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableremotecontr.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable remote control feature.

If this setting is false, client will enable remote control feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

Web also has the same option, which has a higher privilege than this.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableremotesuppo.displayName: Disallow meeting host to provide 1:1 remote support to another participant. This option depends on breakout room settings.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableremotesuppo.description:
Default policy is true.

If this policy is true, client will disallow meeting host to provide 1:1 remote support.

If this setting is false, client will enable remote support feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

Web also has the same option, which has a higher privilege than this.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledarkrightpan.displayName: Set the meeting sidebar to display in dark mode.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledarkrightpan.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, the side panel in meeting will display dark mode.

If this setting is disabled, the side panel appearance will follow setting.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableoriginalsoun.displayName: Client will keep preserve original sound.
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableoriginalsoun.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will keep preserve original sound.

If this setting is disabled, client will not keep preserve original sound and use echo.

If this setting is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablefacebeauty_p.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will enable touching up my appearance.

If this setting is false, client will disable touching up my appearance.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setfacebeautyvalue.displayName: Set the value of "Touch up my appearance"
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setfacebeautyvalue.description:
Default policy is 25.

This policy depends on EnableFaceBeauty, if EnableFaceBeauty is disabled, SetFaceBeautyValue will not work.

If this policy is a valid integer within 0 to 100, client will use the integer as the the value of "Touch up my appearance".

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevirtualbkgn.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable virtual background for meetings.

If this setting is false, client will enable virtual background for meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewhiteboard_.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable white board for meetings.

If this setting is false, client will enable white board for meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableshareaudio_p.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will enable share audio feature.

If this setting is false, client will disable share audio feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablesharevideo_p.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will enable share video feature.

If this setting is false, client will disable share video feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectshare.displayName: Disable to share with Zoom Rooms
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledirectshare.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable the share to Zoom Rooms feature.

If this setting is false, client will enable the share to Zoom Rooms feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disabledesktopshar.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable the share desktop feature.

If this setting is false, client will enable the share desktop feature.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting or user setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableaudiooverpr.displayName: Disable audio media stream over proxy server
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableaudiooverpr.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable the audio media stream over proxy server.

If this setting is false, client will enable the audio media stream over proxy server.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevideooverpr.displayName: Disable video media stream over proxy server
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevideooverpr.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable the video media stream over proxy server.

If this setting is false, client will enable the video media stream over proxy server.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesharingover.displayName: Disable screen sharing media stream over proxy server
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesharingover.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will disable the screen sharing media stream over proxy server.

If this setting is false, client will enable the screen sharing media stream over proxy server.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemdefaul.displayName: Set to use the system default microphone for VoIP
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemdefaul.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will use the system default microphone for VoIP.

If this setting is false, client will use the user setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemdefaul.displayName: Set to use the system default speaker for VoIP
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemdefaul.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will use the system default speaker for VoIP.

If this setting is false, client will use the user setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemcommun.displayName: Set to use the system default communication speaker for VoIP
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemcommun.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will use the system default communication speaker for VoIP.

If this setting is false, client will use the user setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemcommun.displayName: Set to use the system default communication microphone for VoIP
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setusesystemcommun.description:
Default policy is false.

If this policy is true, client will use the system default communication microphone for VoIP.

If this setting is false, client will use the user setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showzoomwinwhensha.displayName: Set to show Zoom windows during screen sharing
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:showzoomwinwhensha.description:
Default policy is hidding Zoom windows during screen sharing.

If this setting is true, client will show Zoom windows during screen sharing.

If this setting is false, client will use the user setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:bandwidthlimitup_p.displayName: Set bandwidth limit up value, like "800" unit Kbps; if it's lower than 800Kbps, the value will be 800Kbps
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:bandwidthlimitup_p.description:
Default policy is no limitation.

If this policy is set, client will restrict media uplink traffic with the limitation.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:bandwidthlimitdown.displayName: Set bandwidth limit down value, like "800" unit Kbps; if it's lower than 800Kbps, the value will be 800Kbps
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:bandwidthlimitdown.description:
Default policy is no limitation.

If this policy is set, client will restrict media downlink traffic with the limitation.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:ignorebandwidthlim.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will ignore bandwidth limits which set by web or GPO/MSI.

If this setting is disabled, client will not ignore bandwidth limits which set by web or GPO/MSI.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableindependentd.displayName: Set to enable independent media data port
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableindependentd.description:
Default policy is no different port.

IIf this setting is true, client will use different ports for media data as below:

AUDIO: 8803
AS: 8802
VIDEO: 8801

If this setting is false, client will use default setting.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:legacycapturemode_.displayName: Disable Hardware Acceleration for Screen Sharing under Share Screen > Advanced
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:legacycapturemode_.description:
Default policy is GPU acceleration enabled.

If this setting is true, client will disable the GPU acceleration.

If this setting is false, client will enable the GPU acceleration.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:annotatehardwareac.displayName: Enable Hardware Acceleration for Annotations under Share Screen > Advanced
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:annotatehardwareac.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is true, client will use hardware acceleration to optimize annotations on the shared screen.

If this setting is false, client will not use hardware acceleration to optimize annotations.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablestartmeeting.displayName: Set to show "Call Room System" button on home panel
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablestartmeeting.description:
Default policy is no "Call Room System" button on home panel.

If this setting is true, client will show the "Call Room System" on home panel and supports to start meeting with Room System directly.

If this setting is false, client will hide above button.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:mutewhenlockscreen.displayName: Set to mute audio and stop video after locking the machine
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:mutewhenlockscreen.description:
Default policy is to send audio and stop video after locking the machine.

If this setting is true, client will mute audio and stop video after locking the machine.

If this setting is false, client will not mute audio and stop video after locking the machine.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:appendcallernamefo.displayName: Set to append caller name for Room system
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:appendcallernamefo.description:
Default policy is not to append caller name for Room system.

If this setting is true, client will append caller name for Room system.

If this setting is false, client will not append caller name for Room system.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabletemporaldeno.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable de-noise.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable de-noise.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablegpucomputeut.displayName: Set to enable hardware acceleration for video processing
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablegpucomputeut.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable hardware acceleration for video processing.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable hardware acceleration for video processing.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareaccf.displayName: Set to enable hardware acceleration for sending video
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareaccf.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable hardware acceleration for sending video.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable hardware acceleration for sending video.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareaccf.displayName: Set to enable hardware acceleration for receiving video
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareaccf.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable hardware acceleration for receiving video.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable hardware acceleration for receiving video.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:sharesessiondisabl.displayName: Set to use TCP connection for screen sharing
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:sharesessiondisabl.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will use TCP connection for screen sharing.

If this setting is disabled, client will use UDP connection for screen sharing.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablespotlightsel.displayName: Set to enable spotlight my video when I speak
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablespotlightsel.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will spotlight my video when I speak.

If this setting is disabled, client will not spotlight my video when I speak.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enable49video_poli.displayName: Set to enable display up to 49 participants per screen in gallery view
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enable49video_poli.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will display up to 49 participants per screen in gallery view.

If this setting is disabled, client will not display up to 49 participants per screen in gallery view.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableremindmeetin.displayName: Set to enable reminding me before upcoming meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableremindmeetin.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will remind me before upcoming meetings with the minutes in setting panel.

If this setting is disabled, client will not remind me before upcoming meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:videorendermethod_.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' as video rendering method.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified rendering method listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Direct3D11 Flip Mode
2 - Direct3D11
3 - Direct3D9
4 - GDI

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presenttoroomoptim.displayName: Client will optimize screen sharing for video clip when user shares directly to a Zoom Room
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presenttoroomoptim.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will optimize screen sharing for video clip when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this setting is disabled, client will not optimize screen sharing for video clip when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presenttoroomoptio.displayName: Set specified sharing option when user shares directly to a Zoom Room
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presenttoroomoptio.description:
Default policy is 1, client will use 'Automatically share desktop' option when user shares directly to a Zoom Room.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified option listed as below:
0 - Show all sharing options
1 - Automatically share desktop

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presentinmeetingop.displayName: Set specified sharing option when user shares screen in a meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:presentinmeetingop.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Show all sharing options' option when user shares screen in a meeting.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified option listed as below:
0 - Show all sharing options
1 - Automatically share desktop

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setscreencapturemo.displayName: Set the specified screen capture mode
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setscreencapturemo.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' as screen capture mode.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified mode listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Legacy operating systems
2 - Capture with window filtering
3 - Advanced share with window filtering
4 - Advanced share without window filtering
5 - Secure share with window filtering

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablevideofilter.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable virtual filters for meetings.

If this setting is disabled, client will enable virtual filters for meetings.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledonotdisturb.displayName: Set to silence system notifications when sharing desktop
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enabledonotdisturb.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will silence system notifications when sharing desktop.

If this setting is disabled, client will not silence system notifications when sharing desktop.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablegpuaccwithsm.displayName: Set to enable hardware acceleration for virtual background
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablegpuaccwithsm.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable hardware acceleration for virtual background.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable hardware acceleration for virtual background.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setsuppressbackgro.displayName: Set a level for suppressing background noise
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setsuppressbackgro.description:
Default policy is 0, client will use 'Auto' by default.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Low
2 - Medium
3 - High

The High option requires the audio enhancement package, and if not present, the client will default to Auto.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setaudiosignalproc.displayName: Set to enable 'signal processing by windows audio device drivers' for windows
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setaudiosignalproc.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Signal processing by windows audio device drivers". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid string, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Off(Windows - Raw)
2 - On(Windows - Default)

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:hidephoneincomingc.displayName: Set to hide incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:hidephoneincomingc.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will hide incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting.

If this setting is disabled, client will show incoming calls while in a Zoom meeting.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableshareclipboa.displayName: Set to enable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableshareclipboa.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable share clipboard when user is screen sharing by default.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableclosedcapti.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable closed captioning.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable closed captioning.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableqna_policy.displayName: Set to disable QnA in the webinar
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableqna_policy.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable QnA in the webinar.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable QnA in the webinar.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableslidecontro.displayName: Set to disable slide control during a presention
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableslidecontro.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable slide control during a presention.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable slide control during a presention.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemanualclose.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable manual captions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable manual captions.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablemeetingreac.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable meeting reactions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable meeting reactions.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablewebinarreac.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable webinar reactions.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable webinar reactions.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablenonverbalfe.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable non-verbal feedback.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable non-verbal feedback.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforceappsigninto.displayName: Set to enforce app local sign in to join Zoom webinar
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforceappsigninto.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom webinar.

If this policy is enabled, Zoom app cannot join webinar before signing in locally.

If this policy is disabled, Zoom app can join webinar without signing in locally.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.displayName: Set to enforce sign in to join Zoom webinar
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enforcesignintojoi.description:
Default policy is no sign in restriction to join Zoom webinar.

If this setting is true, Zoom app cannot join webinar before signing in.

If this setting is false, Zoom app can join webinar without signing in.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareopti.displayName: Enable Hardware Acceleration for Video Sharing under Share Screen > Advanced
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablehardwareopti.description:
Default setting is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will use hardware acceleration to optimize video sharing.

If this setting is disabled, client will not use hardware acceleration to optimize video sharing.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablelightadaptio.displayName: Set to adjust for low light
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablelightadaptio.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will adjust for low light in the user's own video.

If this setting is disabled, client will not adjust for low light in the user's own video.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautolightada.displayName: Set to adjust for low light automatically
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautolightada.description:
Default setting is enabled.

This policy depends on EnableLightAdaption, if EnableLightAdaption is disabled, EnableAutoLightAdaption will not work.

If this setting is enabled, client will adjust for low light in the user's own video automatically.

If this setting is disabled, client will not adjust for low light in the user's own video automatically.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setlightadaptionma.displayName: Set the manual value of "Adjust for low light"
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setlightadaptionma.description:
Default policy is 20.

This policy depends on EnableLightAdaption and EnableAutoLightAdaption, if EnableFaceBeauty is enabled and EnableAutoLightAdaption is disabled, SetLightAdaptionManualValue will take effect.

If this policy is a valid integer within 0 to 100, client will use the integer as the the value of "Adjust for low light".

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautoreversev.displayName: Set to reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautoreversev.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting.

If this setting is disabled, client will not reset virtual backgrounds to default after each meeting.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablebroadcastbo.displayName: Set to disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablebroadcastbo.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable the ability of the host to broadcast messages to breakout rooms.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:overrideenforcesig.displayName: Set to allow users to join other cloud's meetings without login if the EnforceSignInToJoin flag is set
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:overrideenforcesig.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will allow users to join other cloud's meetings(e.g. ZFG) without login even if the EnforceSignInToJoin flag is set.

If this setting is disabled, client will respect EnforceSignInToJoin's logic.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable all intercloud features when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable all intercloud features if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable all intercloud features.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting chat when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable meeting chat if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable meeting chat.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable screen share when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable screen share if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable screen share.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting reactions when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable meeting reactions if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable meeting reactions.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable computer file-transfer when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable computer file-transfer if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable computer file-transfer.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable annotation when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable annotation if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable annotation.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable whiteboard when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable whiteboard if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable whiteboard.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable local recording when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable local recording if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable local recording.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable closed captioning when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable closed captioning if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable closed captioning.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable remote control when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable remote control if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable remote control.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable meeting polls when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable meeting polls if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable meeting polls.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.displayName: Set to disable computer audio when joining other cloud's meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:intercloud_disable.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will disable computer audio if the EnforceSignInToJoin and OverrideEnforceSigninIntercloud flags are set.

If this setting is disabled, when joining other cloud's meetings, client will not disable computer audio.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablelaunchapp4in.displayName: Set to enable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablelaunchapp4in.description:
Default setting is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls.

If this setting is disabled, client will disable launching an external app or a URL for incoming calls.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableinmeetingwh.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, client will disable in-meeting whiteboard.

If this policy is disabled, client will enable in-meeting whiteboard.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setvideorenderingp.displayName: Set to enable video rendering post processing
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setvideorenderingp.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Video"-"Advanced"-"Video Rendering Post Processing". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Enable
2 - Disable

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:setvideocapturingm.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Video"-"Advanced"-"Video Capturing Method". Its default policy is 0, client will default to Auto.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - Auto
1 - Direct Show
2 - Media Foundation

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:notifycmravailable.displayName: Set to show notification when a new recording is available
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:notifycmravailable.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will show notification when a new cloud recording is available.

If this setting is disabled, client will not show notification when a new cloud recording is available.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesidecar_pol.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will disable webinar resources.

If this setting is disabled, client will not disable webinar resources.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:clicktocalldefault.displayName: Set the default dialer for click-to-dial calls
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:clicktocalldefault.description:
Default setting is 0.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified dialer listed as below:
0 - Zoom Phone
1 - Zoom Contact Center

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablediagnostic_p.displayName: Set to enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablediagnostic_p.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services.

If this setting is disabled, client will not enable the diagnostic tool and basic detection of some services.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablezccnativevid.displayName: Force to enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablezccnativevid.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, client will force enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center.

If this setting is disabled, client will not force enable the native video feature of Zoom Contact Center.

If this setting is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:zccmsgaudiosetting.displayName: Setting up message notifications for Zoom Contact Center
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:zccmsgaudiosetting.description:
This policy is exactly same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Contact Center message notifications". Its default policy is 1, client will default to Always play notifications.

If this policy is a valid integer, client will use the specified type listed as below:
0 - No effect
1 - Always play notifications
2 - Mute during meetings and calls
3 - Always mute notifications

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:audioenhancementle.displayName: Turns on windows system enhancements for the speaker and microphone in use
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:audioenhancementle.description:
This policy is exactly the same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Advanced"-"Windows system audio enhancements". Its default policy is 0.

0 - Auto: Default value, using default Windows system setting.
1 - On: Turn on the windows system audio enhancements setting.
2 - Off: Turn off the windows system audio enhancements.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:audiocaptureplayba.displayName: Set audio capture and playback API
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:audiocaptureplayba.description:
This policy is exactly the same as the manual setting: "Settings"-"Audio"-"Advanced"-"Audio capture and playback API". Its default policy is 0.

0 - Auto: Default value, using synchronous Windows API for audio capture and playback.
1 - Windows Audio Session API: Uses synchronous Windows API for audio capture and playback.
2 - Windows Runtime API: Uses asynchronous Windows Runtime API for audio capture and playback.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enablemeshnetworki.description:
Default policy is enabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will allow the users to use mesh feature.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not allow the users to use mesh feature even if they have a mesh plan.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshmulticastip_po.displayName: Set IP address for Zoom Mesh local detection
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshmulticastip_po.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid IP address, this policy will allow admins to specify a valid IP address to be a UDP multicast IP for Zoom apps to declare themselves and detect each other in their local sub-network (255.255.255.0). Admins can choose other IP addresses within the range of [224.0.0.1, 239.255.255.255].

If this policy is empty or invalid, this policy will set as 224.0.0.1 by default.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshmulticastport_.displayName: Set network port for for Zoom Mesh nodes
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshmulticastport_.description:
Default policy is 0.

If this policy is a valid port, client will use this port as the UDP multicast port to communicate with other Zoom Mesh nodes on the network.

If this policy is invalid or 0, this policy will set 36699 as the default port.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshlistenportrang.displayName: Set network port range for Zoom Mesh parent-child node communication
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:meshlistenportrang.description:
Default policy is empty.

If this policy is a valid port range address, the client will use this range to set up listen sockets for connection requests between Mesh parents and children nodes. The nodes will also use this range to send signals and media data.

If this policy is invalid or empty, the client will use "18801-19800" as the default port range.

The format of this string should be "port-port", for example: "18801-19800".

For Zoom Mesh Windows Firewall rules, the configured range must start at port 2000 or higher and span fewer than 5120 ports; otherwise, the firewall rule will not be added.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableguestmesh_po.displayName: Allows users to join an external Webinar as a guest through another account's local Zoom Mesh-enabled network
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableguestmesh_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this setting is enabled, this policy will allow users (not on your account) to join an external Webinar through the local Zoom Mesh-enabled network. Other requirements must be met, such as the device having the minimum supported client version for Mesh connections and the associated account setting in the web portal also enabled.

If this setting is disabled, this policy will not allow external users (not on your account) to join an external Webinar through the local Zoom Mesh-enabled network.

If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:hidecallqueue_poli.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will hide the 'Call Queues' in settings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not hide the 'Call Queues' in settings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:hideblocknumber_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will hide the 'Block Number' feature.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not hide the 'Block Number' feature.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable Zoom Notes for Meetings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable Zoom Notes for Meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesmartmeetin.displayName: Disable Meeting Summary with AI Companion
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablesmartmeetin.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable meeting summary with AI companion.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable meeting summary with AI companion.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableaicqueries_.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable AI Companion questions.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable AI Companion questions.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautocopyconf.displayName: Enable Automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:enableautocopyconf.description:
Default setting is disabled.
If this setting is enabled, client will automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts.
If this setting is disabled, client will not automatically copy invite link once the meeting starts.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableassigntypis.displayName: Disable Allow host to type or assign a participant to type
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableassigntypis.description:
Default setting is disabled.
If this setting is enabled, client will disable allow host to type or assign a participant to type.
If this setting is disabled,  client will not disable allow host to type or assign a participant to type.
If this policy is not set, client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disableinmeetingzo.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, this policy will disable Zoom Docs for Meetings.

If this policy is disabled, this policy will not disable Zoom Docs for Meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:allowedmeetingsurv.displayName: Allow the client to switch to survivable mode
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:allowedmeetingsurv.description:
Default policy is empty.
If this policy is a valid survivability info string, the client can switch to survivable mode.
If this policy is empty, the client does not support survivable mode.

If this policy is not set, client will use default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keepmeetingontop_p.displayName: Force Zoom Meetings on top of other apps during meetings
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:keepmeetingontop_p.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, Zoom Meetings will be forced to sit on top of other apps during meetings.

If this policy is disabled, Zoom Meetings will not be forced to sit on top of other apps during meetings.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:disablelocalasr_po.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, the client will not use local ASR feature.

If this policy is disabled, the client will use local ASR feature.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.

zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:optimizeslidecontr.displayName: Enable the use of Office API to control PowerPoint slides
zoommeetings_hklm_7_2:optimizeslidecontr.description:
Default policy is disabled.

If this policy is enabled, clients will be able to use the Office API to control PowerPoint slides.

If this policy is disabled, clients will be unable to use the Office API to control PowerPoint slides.

If this policy is not set, the client will use the default setting.
